prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: create a third compositional option for "Inference Track", a personal eight-week production LLM inference roadmap tracker for a Java backend engineer.
Surface structure: compose the app like an engineering run ledger with a narrow vertical index on the left containing eight numbered ruled entries, not a generic navigation sidebar. Each entry shows week number, short focus, and a tiny evidence count. The remaining wide canvas is one active run sheet for "Week 03 · Benchmarking & tuning". Begin with a compact header line showing overall progress and hours. Below, make a large sequential checklist the focal point, each deliverable occupying a ruled band with completion state and a one-line definition of done. A narrow proof-of-work column is integrated on the far right of the same bands. A full-width notes field closes the sheet at the bottom. Show enough of the eight-week index to understand the whole roadmap.
Content: "01 Foundations", "02 Java gateway", "03 Benchmarking", "04 Quantization", "05 Observability", "06 Kubernetes", "07 Reliability", "08 Capstone". Deliverables: "Run an open-loop load test", "Record TTFT, TPOT, queue time", "Publish the benchmark report". Labels: "OVERALL · 32%", "HOURS · 6 / 16", "EVIDENCE", "WEEK NOTES".
Visual world: contemporary inference benchmark result sheet and lab run log. Off-white matte ground, near-black ink, deep green status ink, pale sage rules. Precise square controls, tabular figures, restrained status stamps, minimal rounded corners, no floating cards.
Typography: practical, compact, highly legible workhorse sans; technical face for week codes and metrics.
Focal moment: the three ruled deliverable bands and their evidence cells; the current week marker is unmistakable.
Constraints: polished shippable product UI, not concept art or poster; accessible contrast; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no photography; no illustrations; no decorative icons; no charts beyond a single linear progress indicator; no fabricated benchmark numbers; no top navigation; no watermark.
